name: Combined Volumetric and Geometric Ambient Occlusion
aliases: Combined Occlusion Effects for Combined Volumes and Tubular Geometry
Directional Occlusion Shading (DOS) with Volumetric and Geometric Occlusion
definition: A rendering method that computes combined occlusion effects between volumetric data and geometric structures (e.g., streamlines) to enhance depth perception. It addresses the lack of depth discrimination in separate volumetric and geometric occlusion methods by integrating shadows cast by geometry into volume, volume onto geometry, and geometry onto geometry.
